finding: Text with formulaic, repetitive, statistical structure activates the periodic circuit most strongly
q1_periodic_hidden_states: No — effective rank is uniformly ~1.1 for all text at layer 8. The circuit does not produce periodic hidden states on text.
q2_concurrent_activation: Yes — sports statistics (tennis, football, baseball) and medical/weather text activate the MLP cascade (L3-L8) concurrently.
